narrative:
Cuyahoga County has 876,443 registered voters, with 13.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 10.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 60.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 50.6 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 28.6% of registrants. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +11.1% D−R vs +26.5% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
